#LOAD PACKAGES 

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(qs)
library(ewastools)
library(ggpubr)
library(qqman)
library(ggplot2)
library(grid)
library(IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19)
library(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19)
library(methylGSA)

```

#IMPORT EWAS RESULTS

```{r}

# M1/Health Only
load("Output/EWAS/resultsm1_childrural_hm.rda")
h_rural <- results_rural_hannotated
rm(results_rural_hannotated)

load("Output/EWAS/resultsm1_schlyrs_h.rda")
h_schlyrs <- results_schlyrs_hannotated
rm(results_schlyrs_hannotated)

load("Output/EWAS/resultsm1_livegpar_h.rda")
h_livegpar <- results_livegpar_hannotated
rm(results_livegpar_hannotated)

load("Output/EWAS/resultsm1_chsmk_h.rda")
h_chsmk <- results_chsmk_hannotated
rm(results_chsmk_hannotated)


# M2/Health, socioeconomic, and behavior Variables
load("Output/EWAS/resultsm2_childrural_h2.rda")
sh_rural <- results_rural_hannotated2
rm(results_rural_hannotated2)

load("Output/EWAS/resultsm2_schlyrs_h2.rda")
sh_schlyrs <- results_schlyrs_hannotated2
rm(results_schlyrs_hannotated2)

load("Output/EWAS/resultsm2_livegpar_h2.rda")
sh_livegpar <- results_livegpar_hannotated2
rm(results_livegpar_hannotated2)

load("Output/EWAS/resultsm2_chsmk_h2.rda")
sh_chsmk <- results_chsmk_hannotated2
rm(results_chsmk_hannotated2)


# M3/Primary
load("Output/EWAS/resultsm3_rural_ds8.rda")
rural_smk_8 <- results_rural_ds8annotated
rm(results_rural_ds8annotated)

load("Output/EWAS/resultsm3_livegpar_ds10.rda")
livegpar_smk_10 <- results_livegpar_ds10annotated
rm(results_livegpar_ds10annotated)

load("Output/EWAS/resultsm3_schlyrs_ds9.rda")
schlyrs_m3 <- results_schlyrs_ds9annotated
rm(results_schlyrs_ds9annotated)

load("Output/EWAS/resultsm3_chsmk_ds.rda")
chsmk_ds <- results_chsmk_dsannotated
rm(results_chsmk_dsannotated)

```

## LOAD IN FUNCTIONS

```{r}

source('EWAS_function.R')

```

# GENE SET ENRICHMENT

### M1/Health Only

```{r}

cpg_pvalues <- h_rural$P.Value
names(cpg_pvalues) <- h_rural$CpG
gsa_result1 <- methylGSA::methylRRA(cpg.pval = cpg_pvalues,
                               array.type = "EPIC",
                               method = "GSEA")

cpg_pvalues <- h_schlyrs$P.Value
names(cpg_pvalues) <- h_schlyrs$CpG
gsa_result2 <- methylGSA::methylRRA(cpg.pval = cpg_pvalues,
                               array.type = "EPIC",
                               method = "GSEA")

cpg_pvalues <- h_livegpar$P.Value
names(cpg_pvalues) <- h_livegpar$CpG
gsa_result3 <- methylGSA::methylRRA(cpg.pval = cpg_pvalues,
                               array.type = "EPIC",
                               method = "GSEA")

cpg_pvalues <- h_chsmk$P.Value
names(cpg_pvalues) <- h_chsmk$CpG
gsa_result4 <- methylGSA::methylRRA(cpg.pval = cpg_pvalues,
                               array.type = "EPIC",
                               method = "GSEA")


```

### M2/Health, socioeconomic, and behavior Variables


### M3/Primary

```{r}

cpg_pvalues <- rural_smk_8$P.Value
names(cpg_pvalues) <- rural_smk_8$CpG
gsa_result9 <- methylGSA::methylRRA(cpg.pval = cpg_pvalues,
```

## EXPORT

```{r}

sheets_methylGSA = list('childrural(Health)' = gsa_result1, 'childrural(Health+Socioeconomic+Behavior)' = gsa_result5, 'childrural(Primary)' = gsa_result9, 'SCHLYRS(Health)' = gsa_result2, 'SCHLYRS(Health+Socioeconomic+Behavior)' = gsa_result6, 'SCHLYRS(Primary)' = gsa_result10, 'LIVEGPAR(Health)' = gsa_result3, 'LIVEGPAR(Health+Socioeconomic+Behavior)' = gsa_result7, 'LIVEGPAR(Primary)' = gsa_result11, 'CHSMOKE(Health)' = gsa_result4, 'CHSMOKE(Health+Socioeconomic+Behavior)' = gsa_result8, 'CHSMOKE(Primary)' = gsa_result12)
writexl::write_xlsx(sheets_methylGSA, 'Manuscript/EWAS/Supplemental Table 10-Gene Ontology Pathway Enrichment Results.xlsx')

```
